sections.content: Object-oriented programming organizes code around objects: classes define the blueprint (fields + methods), objects are the instances.

Core ideas: encapsulation (hide internals), inheritance (reuse via parent classes), polymorphism (same interface, different behavior). You have already used objects — strings and lists are objects in most languages!
Key points: start with simple data-grouping before deep hierarchies, and prefer composition (has-a) over deep inheritance (is-a).
